verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/PEO product, so configuring multiple pay schedules across teams is an applicable axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents pay schedules or pay frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), or assigning different schedules to different groups. The department- and office-level overrides cover Xero accounting mappings, and the 'policy cycle' covers time-off policies; both are adjacent features and earn no credit here.
